info.split: all 1000 dev queries; 5000-document controlled subset of 100999, all labelled positives retained
info.scope: Passage relevance only. Original passages can contain erroneous advice; never imported into production library or certified as medical truth.

methods.scope: Dense-first fallback only; no manually reviewed clinical graph in these public sets. Post-hoc development policy, not held-out validation.

latency_scope: Retrieval core including real query encoding and reranking; excludes HTTP/SQLite document loading and generation. Corpus encoding not part of query latency. One measured pass after explicit warm-up.
